# The toolbar migration rewrites only legacy collapsed strings below UI version62

This landing maps a persisted collapsed value of false to the missing-attribute sentinel and true to an empty string for four specific toolbar/window targets when the prior UI version is below62. Missing and already-current stored forms are left alone. A zero stored version bypasses the blocks as a new-profile case. The new non-mac Marionette test covers six stored-value cases, with compose DOM checks; four new assertions lack messages. Later accepted source adds a compose-readiness wait. Required primary comments are absent, so this remains source-supported partial knowledge with zero full-audit credit; no profile or test ran.

Scope: Mail UI persistent toolbar migration.
